title: Without Invoicing View, work order and part sale invoices are plain text
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access", "Work Orders → View", "Part Sales → View" but not "Invoicing & Payments → View", with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-13 User with the custom role ZZAUTOTEST S7-13 Role; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an overdue work order invoice {Invoice-A} and an overdue part sale invoice {Invoice-B}, both made at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-13 No Invoicing.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Customer-A}'s group expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both are plain text.
  • Step 2: nothing opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-N2: “A document the user lacks the permission for shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R1: “A document number is a link only when the user has the permission to open it and can open it in its own location; otherwise it shows as plain text.”
  • Story 7 Prerequisites: “An invoice or part sale opens for a user with 'Invoicing & Payments → View' and 'Work Orders → View' (work orders) or 'Part Sales → View' (part sales).”
